screenbrowser-skill-screenbrowser.description: Produce a narrated tutorial video of a web app with Screen Browser. Use when asked to "make a tutorial video", "record a walkthrough", "create a product demo" or "document this feature as a video" for the app whose source code you are working in. Writes a plain-language guide from the codebase, hands it to the Screen Browser MCP server (create project, upload guides, start the run) and brings back the video.
